title: The Constrained Application Protocol (CoAP)
summary: Specifies the Constrained Application Protocol (CoAP), a web transfer protocol for very small devices and lossy, low-power networks. It offers a request/response model, resource discovery, and web concepts like URIs and media types, while keeping overhead low. It maps easily to HTTP and supports multicast.

eli5.summary: CoAP is like the web, but made for tiny gadgets that cannot afford long messages. It lets small sensors and switches ask for and send information with very short notes.
